---
title: Sous Vide Prime Rib with Mint Persillade
source: America's Test Kitchen How to Make The Ultimate Sous Vide Prime Rib with Mint Persillade
source_url: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LysF3BGtXt4
tags: [prime-rib, sous-vide, beef, holiday]
---

== step trim ==
Trim most of the fat from the @prime rib roast{}, leaving a thin layer on top
to help prevent moisture loss.

== step bones ==
Separate the rib bones from the meat. Use a thin, sharp #knife{} and cut right
along the bone.

== step score ==
Score a crosshatch pattern into the fat cap, but do not cut deep enough to reach
the meat.

== step salt ==
Rub @kosher salt{2%tbsp} all over the roast. Try to get some salt between the
cuts made in the fat cap.

== step dry brine ==
Rest the roast uncovered in the refrigerator for ~dry brine{24-96%hours} so the
surface dries out slightly.
